import importlib,importlib.util,json,pathlib,subprocess
root=pathlib.Path.cwd();control=root.parent/'.sae-w162-control-20261109'
spec=importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('bench',root/'tools/bench_b0.py');bench=importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec);spec.loader.exec_module(bench)
s=importlib.import_module('torchoed.d_optimal_design');torch=bench.torch;torch.set_num_threads(1)
oldscreen,oldgather=s._linear_screen,s._linear_gather4;current={};outputs=[]
def screen(*args):
 keep=oldscreen(*args);current['nonempty_tiles']+=int(keep.any());return keep
def gather(*args):
 current['calls']+=1;current['rows']+=len(args[3]);current['empty_calls']+=int(len(args[3])==0);return oldgather(*args)
s._linear_screen=screen;s._linear_gather4=gather
base=json.loads((root/'reports/w155/results.json').read_text(encoding='utf-8'));matches=errors=0;counts=[]
for case in base['cases']:
 F=bench.polynomial_features(torch.tensor(case['candidates'],dtype=torch.float64),degree=2)
 for row in case['per_restart']:
  if row['criterion']=='D':continue
  current=dict(calls=0,rows=0,nonempty_tiles=0,empty_calls=0)
  try:result=bench.optimal_design(F,case['n'],criterion=row['criterion'],restarts=1,generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(row['seed']))
  except ValueError as exc:
   assert row['error']==type(exc).__name__+': '+str(exc);errors+=1;continue
  out=dict(case=f"{case['pool']} n={case['n']}",criterion=row['criterion'],seed=row['seed'],ids=result['ids'].tolist(),objective=result['objective'])
  assert out['ids']==row['ids'] and out['objective']==row['objective'];matches+=1;outputs.append(out)
  if case['pool']=='random500' and case['n']==20 and row['seed']==0:
   assert current['empty_calls']==0 and current['calls']<=current['nonempty_tiles'];counts.append(dict(criterion=row['criterion'],**current));print(counts[-1],flush=True)
assert (matches,errors)==(80,10)
data=dict(source_sha=subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),matches=matches,errors_equal=errors,outputs=outputs,gather_counts=counts,adapter=pathlib.Path(__file__).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
(control/'untimed-quality.json').write_text(json.dumps(data,allow_nan=False)+'\n',encoding='utf-8');print('PASS',matches,'errors equal',errors,flush=True)
